x: In the 100 metres 1st string our sprinter from British Guiana, Ivan Mayers, showed a clean pair of heels to his rivals to record 11.2 secs. In the 2nd string race Ron Morrell finished third, with P.
Gordon was 3rd, with Ron Morrell 5th in the Senior 100 and John Burr and Archie Bedford were 3rd and 4th in the 1 mile, which was won in 4 mins. 25 secs. by Brian Hewson, of Mitcham.
Ray Tooby won the 660 yards Senior, with Jim Heathfield in 2nd place, and Bob Wolton won the Senior 300 yards, with Ron Morrell in 4th place.

We also won the 1 miles medley relay, with Jim Heathfield, Bob Wolton, Ron Morrell and Ivan Mayers. In the Junior match we again triumphed, with 29 pts., with Shaftesbury H., 22 ; and Ealing and Maidenhead, 8 each.
On June 3rd we sent a team to Morden for a 4 x 176 yds. relay, and on a rough track our team of Ron Holtum, John Benstead, Ron Morrell and Dudley Gordon ran out winners of a close race.
Benstead (4) second and Ron Morrell (8) in third place. In the 1 mile handicap we saw a new member, K.
Our team of Ian Badiali, Ron Morrell, Bob Wolton and " Jock " Cameron also won the 1 mile scratch relay in the good time of 3 mins. 36.8 secs.
